ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a circle, and points V, T, and U are all on the circumference. From V, two chords are drawn respectively toward T and U, forming angle ∠TVU with its vertex on the circumference; the figure labels this angle as 23°. The problem asks to find the degree measure of arc TU. Reasoning: ∠TVU is an inscribed angle, and the arc it intercepts is TU. According to the inscribed angle theorem, the measure of an inscribed angle is equal to half the measure of the arc it intercepts, so the degree measure of arc TU is equal to 2 × 23° = 46°.
